items.title: Bobby Johnson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: when he found out I was a singer then that’s when he wanted me to join his band.

ctx.x: Plus he was a — Don Redman was a great arranger too, right?

Yeah. And Don Reel. And nowadays, you hear some of his stuff nowadays, “Chant of the Weeds” — have you ever heard that tune? Yeah “Chant of the Weeds,” that was his theme song. Yeah. “Chant of the Weeds” and all that kind of stuff. Nowadays — Then, I was a singer, like I told you, and during those days — before I go any further I have to tell you this — I wrote all this stuff out two days ago, and I left it at home when I was coming out here today, for some reason or other. But during those days, Don had a song…
Yeah, sure, you make yourself more valuable too.
